question: Why is there a three second wait here?

claims.text: The wait is a hack I added because the tax vendor rate-limits us. Two requests from the same account within 3 seconds get a 429, and their support confirmed there is no burst allowance.

citations.quote: The vendor returns 429 if two requests from the same account land within 3 seconds, and their support confirmed there is no burst allowance.

claims.text: Without the delay the nightly batch lost about 8% of quotes. I knew a delay was not the right fix and that a queue was.

citations.quote: Without the delay the nightly batch loses about 8% of quotes. Proper fix is a queue.

claims.text: The later rename kept the delay and added a TODO to remove it after migrating to a new tax vendor. I didn't write that commit. It is a refactor that renamed variables and pulled the 3000 into PAUSE_MS.

citations.quote: // TODO: remove this delay after migrating to the new tax vendor

answer.voice: Dmitri Volkov, first person, plain and direct
